title: Models | Boardwalk Docs
evidence: Catalog independently lists exactly the two models at matching input/output values. It explicitly identifies USD per million tokens. The catalog has two rows; capability qualification is not verified. Public IDs identify repository models rather than private deployments.

title: Pricing | Boardwalk Docs
evidence: Ordinary catalog inference uses prepaid credit token billing, separate from private deployment GPU-time billing. Cache read and write are distinct from uncached input; generation includes reasoning. No reported cache counts means prompt is billed uncached. New organizations have no initial credit and must purchase at least $5 before service. Prices are revision-specific, not traffic-dependent.

title: Metering and receipts | Boardwalk Docs
evidence: Token categories are separated on receipt. Output includes reasoning and tool calls. Rates use integer microdollars per million tokens; sum category charges, divide by one million, round up once to whole microdollar per request. Unknown cache counts are null, not zero. Example receipt rates are illustrative, not model rate evidence.
